verdict.rationale: Offloading to a hosted cloud tier is a fair question for a model-serving or inference product, but the evidence pack shows no vLLM-operated hosted tier or remote offload that avoids downloading weights. vLLM is documented as a self-installed engine (pip/uv, Docker) that loads Hugging Face models onto the user's own hardware. Quantization and distributed parallelism help run large models on that hardware, but they do not provide a hosted cloud tier.
